acceptance.source_clause: Human Intent Hypothesis is grounded in original requirement, preconditions and falsifier; wrong premise cannot become proven.
Source rights and identity admissible; unlicensed asset, wrong SHA or wrong target refused.
Actual task-level AST/SCIP Migration Dependency Retrieval measures target Precision ≥99% against frozen ground truth and publishes Recall/Coverage/abstentions.
Dependency closure spans symbols, imports, registrations, assets and observed dynamic edges; missing critical edge blocks `CLOSED`.
Original and target are separately executed native runtimes, not REA/HAR replay masquerading as execution.
Authorized action changes actual target worktree/program state; foreign/unauthorized mutation is refused.
Mutation→Reset→readback restores clean worktree/process/browser/fixture state without cross-episode contamination.
Mathematical parity validates differential results, properties, metamorphic/boundary inputs and predeclared numeric error policy.
Producer→Consumer guarantees and Consumer→Producer prerequisites/feedback/exception obligations are both tested in scope.
Selected DOM/ARIA/focus/events/network/filesystem/persistence behavior and side-effect order remain contracted.
Plant false-equivalence, bad error, order and over-inference negatives; verifier rejects them.
Reward is independent and resists forged trace, agent self-score, changed Oracle and insufficient hard-gate evidence.
Native Evals are source-bound to correct SPEC/V/G revisions via original FactoryWeaver producer; unsupported changes do not become truth.
Source revision change, stale evidence, wrong card version, missing link and dependency updates yield targeted invalidation/recovery.

In the same supervising Session, Source/Owner-bound Outer reasoning (or NOOP) is consumed by the next authorized unsealed Poteto Stage; real inner feedback changes only warranted subsequent decisions/cards. Fresh Native Consumer and original Owner readback prove the handoff, not documentation.
Evaluation-first reproducible baseline, proper held-out split, success/failure/cost/latency/refusal/coverage metrics.
RL-ready vs trained-policy outcomes remain separate; no training improvement claims without actual controlled weights/checkpoints/held-out comparison.

Whole original Human Goal **and** applicable FactoryWeaver card obligations (revision/NOOP + native consumer uptake), remaining REQ inventory, real independent evidence and original Owner effect/readback converge; partial green, card DONE, unknown-write or cognitive NOOP cannot falsely close the parent goal.
